Test Description: Test dashboard analytics engine with real-time data processing and complex statistical calculations

Test Case Title: Data Integration and ETL (Extract Transform Load) Testing
Test Description: Test data integration capabilities including external data sources and automated data processing
Specialized Test Steps:
1. Test External Data Source Integration:
   - CSV file import: Student records, attendance data, activity schedules
   - Excel spreadsheet import: Budget data, resource allocation, staff schedules
   - Database integration: Connect to external student information systems
   - API integration: Third-party healthcare systems, government databases
   - Real-time data feeds: IoT sensors, attendance scanners, mobile apps
2. Test Data Extraction Processes:
   - Scheduled data extraction from external systems (daily at 2 AM)
   - Manual data extraction with user-initiated import
   - Incremental data extraction (only new/changed records)
   - Full data refresh with complete dataset replacement
   - Error handling for extraction failures and data source unavailability
3. Test Data Transformation Rules:
   - Data type conversion (text to number, date format standardization)
   - Data validation and cleansing (remove duplicates, fix inconsistencies)
   - Data mapping (external field names to internal schema)
   - Calculated fields and derived values (age from birthdate, etc.)
   - Data normalization and standardization rules
4. Test Data Loading and Validation:
   - Load processed data into target tables
   - Referential integrity checking (foreign key validation)
   - Data quality validation rules (required fields, format validation)
   - Duplicate detection and resolution strategies
   - Error reporting and failed record handling
5. Test ETL Performance and Scalability:
   - Process large datasets (50,000+ records) efficiently
   - Parallel processing for multiple data sources
   - Memory usage optimization during large imports
   - Database transaction management for data consistency
   - Recovery mechanisms for interrupted ETL processes
6. Test Data Synchronization:
   - Bi-directional sync with external systems
   - Conflict resolution for simultaneous updates
   - Change tracking and audit trails for synchronized data
   - Sync frequency optimization (real-time vs. batch)
   - Data consistency verification across systems
7. Test Data Security During Integration:
   - Encryption of data in transit and at rest
   - Secure authentication for external system connections
   - Data masking for sensitive information (PII, medical data)
   - Access control for ETL processes and imported data
   - Compliance with data protection regulations (GDPR, HIPAA)
8. Test Error Handling and Recovery:
   - Network failures during data extraction
   - Malformed data handling and error reporting
   - Partial load recovery (resume from failure point)
   - Data rollback mechanisms for failed imports
   - Notification systems for ETL failures
9. Test Data Lineage and Auditing:
   - Track data source and transformation history
   - Audit trail for all data changes and imports
   - Data quality metrics and monitoring
   - Impact analysis for data schema changes
   - Compliance reporting for data processing activities
10. Test Integration Monitoring and Alerting:
    - Real-time monitoring of ETL job status
    - Performance metrics tracking (throughput, error rates)
    - Automated alerts for ETL failures or anomalies
    - Dashboard for ETL process management
    - Scheduled health checks for external data sources
Expected Result: Data integration processes work reliably with comprehensive error handling. ETL performance meets requirements for large datasets. Data quality and security are maintained throughout the integration process.
Analytics Validation Points:
1. External data source connectivity:
   - All configured data sources accessible and responsive
   - Authentication mechanisms work for all external systems
   - Connection pooling and timeout handling work correctly
   - Fallback mechanisms activate when sources unavailable
   - SSL/TLS encryption verified for all connections
2. Data extraction accuracy:
   - Extracted data matches source system exactly
   - Incremental extraction captures all new/changed records
   - Date range filtering works correctly for historical data
   - Large dataset extraction completes without data loss
   - Error handling preserves data integrity

   - Validation rules catch all data quality issues
   - Field mapping correctly associates source and target fields
   - Calculated fields use correct business logic formulas
   - Standardization rules applied consistently
4. Loading process reliability:
   - Target database updated correctly with new data
   - Referential integrity maintained throughout load process
   - Duplicate handling follows configured business rules
   - Failed records reported with clear error descriptions
   - Transaction boundaries ensure data consistency
5. Performance benchmarks:
   - 50,000 record dataset processes in <30 minutes
   - Memory usage stays under 2GB during large imports
   - Parallel processing improves throughput by 50%+
   - Database remains responsive during ETL operations
   - Recovery from interruption completes successfully
